description: Adobe's code for Fixed Point Mathematics, defining fixed point types, macros, and functions for 32-bit fixed point arithmetic, used in font rendering or graphics processing.

methods.name: cf2_intToFixed
methods.description: Converts an integer to 16.16 fixed point format.

methods.name: cf2_fixedToInt
methods.description: Converts a 16.16 fixed point number to an integer.

methods.name: cf2_fixedRound
methods.description: Rounds a fixed point number to the nearest 16.16 fixed point.

methods.name: cf2_floatToFixed
methods.description: Converts a floating-point number to 16.16 fixed point.

methods.name: cf2_fixedAbs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of a fixed point number.

methods.name: cf2_fixedFloor
methods.description: Returns the integer part of a fixed point number.

methods.name: cf2_fixedFraction
methods.description: Returns the fractional part of a fixed point number.

methods.name: cf2_fracToFixed
methods.description: Converts a 14.2 fixed point number to 16.16 fixed point.
